steps.title: Pick a topic
steps.body: Build an AI model, or research an AI concept and explain it. Any topic works; the list below is a starting point from the officers.

steps.title: Send in your idea
steps.body: Submit your idea through the form so an officer can check in and help you scope it.

steps.title: Build it
steps.body: Most projects run in Google Colab, so there's nothing to install. Email the club with any questions while you work.

steps.title: Present it
steps.body: Members present their projects at meetings throughout the year. Finished projects get posted on this page.
